classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve representative sequences for GO:0052855 activity, analyze the family, and submit one acceptable representative amino-acid sequence with final Reason and Answer fields.
assumptions: Use the literature-grounded family-sequence template to anchor the request to GO:0052855 and retrieve a reproducible UniProt family snapshot with a fixed temporal cutoff.

The representative will be selected from retrieved natural sequences rather than designed de novo; acceptability is based on GO-linked family context plus basic sequence sanity from sequence_analysis.
If literature grounding does not resolve to GO:0052855, the round should stop before final submission rather than submit an off-target candidate.
Provider selected a workflow template by reference; expanded it to the validated local workflow descriptor.

workflow_plan.name: semantic_constraint_to_family_sequences
workflow_plan.description: Retrieve literature for a semantic goal, extract a GO term, collect matching sequences, and summarize the family FASTA.

success_criteria.Reason: Provide a concise rationale linking the selected representative to GO:0052855 evidence and the retrieved family-level sequence analysis.
success_criteria.Answer: Provide the selected amino-acid sequence only.
success_criteria.submission: If an acceptable representative is found in the retrieved family, explicitly submit it as the final candidate.
success_criteria.acceptability: The submitted sequence must come from the retrieved GO:0052855 family set and appear family-consistent under sequence_analysis without obvious low-complexity or major liability red flags.
